0022600140.text: The Denver Nuggets (1-2, 1-1 at home, 0-1 on the road) take on the New Orleans Pelicans (0-3, on a three-game losing streak) in the Nuggets' fourth game of the season, with Denver sitting 10th in the West and New Orleans 14th. Denver will be without Alpha Diallo (out, personal reason), Julian Strawther (out, knee sprain) and Spencer Jones (out, hamstring), while Cameron Johnson (ankle sprain) is day-to-day and a game-time decision; New Orleans is missing Yves Missi (out, knee bruise), and Jordan Poole is day-to-day with an illness and a game-time decision. The Nuggets lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after their 141-135 win in Denver on October 24, and they won the 2025-26 series 3-0.
